tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༈/gnyis pa chags bral gyi rnal 'byor la/rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/dang po la rlung sbyang
༈/gnyis pa chags bral gyi rnal 'byor la/rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/dang po la rlung sbyang

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ /gnyis pa chags bral gyi rnal 'byor la/ rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po la rlung sbyang ba dang*/ bsdu ba dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas shin tu dben par bsam gtan gyi stan la rkang pa gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi mthe bong lto sbyar ba lte 'og tu bcar/ sgal tshigs dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrang*/ ol kos ol mdud non pa tsamaṃ mgo bo cung zad dud par gug mig gnyis smin mtshams kyi thad kyi bar snang du har rer blta ba'am sna rtser dbab/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs/ so dang ma chu rang babs su gzhag lce rtse rkan la sbyar ba ste lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas pas sgom gegs zhi/ sgrib pa byang*/ ye shes skye ba sogs phan yon dpag med 'byin pa spre'u'i gtam rgyud lta bu yin gsungs/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas zhar byung rdzogs rim yan chad rgyun gyi nyams len ltar ram/ yang na bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma dang rang sems 'dres pa'i ngang de ga las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor ma sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs sogs yongs su rdzogs par khra lam gyis gsal gdab/ de'i sku lus thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin dar dmar gyi gur phub pa'am phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i phyi gsal nang gsal snyan gshog dang phyag zhabs kyi sor rtse tshun chad stong sang nge ba'i stong ra bsgoms pas gegs mi 'byung*/ de nas rang lus 'od kyi rang bzhin de'i dbus drang por rtsa ro rkyang gnyis 'dus kyi ngo bo/ rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam yar sne spyi gtsug tu klad rgyas kyi thad du zug pa zla dkyil chung ngus kha bcad pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam du zug pa sngar bshad pa'i khyad chos bzhi ldan du gsal gdab/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chung ngus smyug tshigs ltar khad chad du bkag par bsam/

dbu ma'i yar sne klad rgyas kyi nang du chu rlung gi rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ g.yas su sa rlung gi rang bzhin ām̐ ser po/ rgyab tu me rlung gi rang bzhin dzrīṃ dmar po/ g.yon du rlung rlung gi rang bzhin kham̐ ljang gu/ mdun du nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po ste dpa' bo 'bru lnga po mgo gyen bstan du gsal gdab/ de nas rlung ro sbyang ba la/ lag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yas bkag nas rlung g.yon nas sangs kyis lan gsum bus la zhe sdang gi rtog pa rnams dag par mos/ de nas lag g.yon gyi rtse gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgyas sna phug g.yon bkag ste rlung ro sangs kyis g.yas nas lan gsum bus la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa rnams dag par mos/ de nas sna bug gnyis ka nas lan gsum bus la gti mug gi rtog pa byang bar mos te dgu phrugs su bsal/ de nas dbu ma'i yas sne'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi me long ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po de la thim pas me long ye shes dang chu rlung gi ngo bo thig le dkar po sran ma'am/ yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam du gyur/ de dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil chung ngu ma de'i dbus su hril gyis babs par bsams la/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul par brngubs la mchil ma sgra med cig nang du bsgyur/ 'og rlung las 'og sgo zum tsam byas nas rlung kha sbyor bum pa can gzung zhing dmigs pa bskyed/ mi thub na dal bus rang 'gros su gtang*/ de 'dra yang yang bya/ yang dbu ma'i yas sne'i g.yas kyi ām̐ ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi mnyam nyid ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od ser po'i rnam par bsdu/ ām̐ la thim pas mnyam nyid ye shes dang sa rlung gi ngo bo thig le ser por gyur nas/

mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng g.yas su babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i dzrīṃ dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sor rtog ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam par bsdus/ dzrīṃ la thim pas sor rtog ye shes dang me rlung gi ngo bo thig le dmar por gyur nas/ mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng rgyab tu babs par bsams la/ sngar ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i kham̐ ljang gu las 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi bya grub ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od ljang gu'i rnam par bsdus/ kham̐ la thim pas bya grub ye shes dang rlung rlung gi ngo bo thig le ljang gur gyur nas/ mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng g.yon du babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi chos dbyings ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ hūm̐ la thim pas chos dbyings ye shes dang nam mkha'i rlung gi ngo bo thig le sngon por gyur nas mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng du babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ de nas dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng du dbus su thig le dkar po/ g.yas su ser po/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar po/ mdun du sngon po rnams la sems bzung nas/ rlung kha sbyor ci thub thub tu 'dzin/ rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi gnad dang nus pa thams cad thig le de rnams la tshang tshul legs par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung lnga'i kha dog so sor mthong ba sogs rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur ro gsungs// ༈ /gnyis pa rlung sems la bcug nas stong pa sgrub pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma yar sne smin mtshams dang*/ mar sne gsang gnas su thad bcad kyi rnam pas bu ga har rer yod par bsam/

smin mtshams kyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le kha dog lnga ldan khra chem mer ba/ sran chung tsam bde ba'i rang bzhin can zhig bsgom/ de nyid dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'dril te spyi gtsug dbu ma'i gug mtshams nang der/ ri mthon po'i rtse la skar chen shar ba ltar 'dar phril ler yod par bsam/ de la dmigs pa gtad pas de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun long gis 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang zhing*/ de las kyang phyir 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas rang lus 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan du bsgyur/ slar yang 'od kha dog lnga ldan lus kyi phyi rol du 'phros pas/ gnas khang yul ljongs sa phyogs stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khams gsum gyi snod bcud thams cad la reg pa tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i rnam rol 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin du bun long nge*/ khra shig ge ba'i rnam par bsams la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i nyams gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa rang rig rang ngo shes tsam du mnyam par bzhag de nas phyi rol gyi 'od de dag thams cad tshur 'dus/ rang lus 'ja' tshon du gyur pa la thim/ de'ang rim gyis tshur 'dus/ spyi gtsug gi rtsa ba'i thig le kha dog lnga ldan de la thim/ de nyid kyang je phra je phras rang yal du song bar bsams la/ bde stong gnyis med kyi nyams gsal stong 'dzin med du rang rig rang ngo shes tsam du mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba dang*/ stong nyid de'i ngang las rang gi smin mtshams kyis tshod de ga'i thad du thig le kha dog lnga ldan khra chem gyis thol byung bar bsam/ de nas rang lus lha sku dang*/ dbu ma bcas sngar ltar gsal btab la/ smin mtshams kyi thig ler sems gzung*/ yang spyi bor spo/ rang dang snod bcud 'ja' 'od du bsgyur ba stong nyid la mnyam par gzhag pa sogs sngar ltar dmigs pa bskyar/ de ltar bsgom pa ni/ rlung lus la bcug pas khams kyi snyigs ma dwangs mar bsgyur zhing*/

rlung sems la bcug pas dwangs ma 'ja' lus stong gzugs 'od skur sgyur bar byed pa'i thabs bla na med pa ste/ yun ring du goms par byas pas 'byongs rtags su lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa/ shing bal ltar yangs ba/ grib ma mi 'byung ba'am srab pa/ lag pa sogs nyi zer la bltas pas phyi gsal nang gsal lta bu 'byung ba/ rkang rjes chung du 'gro ba/ 'od kha dog lnga ldan du mthong ba/ sgrub khang la 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug pa/ 'ja' gur phub pa sogs 'byongs rtags byung tshe de brtan par bya ba'i phyir kun 'dar gsang spyod ces thog mar rlung gi reg bya lta bus sngar mi bzod pa'i grang ngad che sa zhig tu bsdad la/ rang lus snod bcud 'ja' tshon du khra shig shig bun long long du gyur pa la dmigs pa gtad nas stong nyid bsgoms pas/ sngar rlung gi grang reg mi bzod pa zhig 'chang ba de mi 'byung bar bde chen du lhang lhang 'char gin 'dug na/ me'i 'od dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ chu sogs la sngar ltar sbyangs shing brtag de dag gis mi gnod par bde ba'i grogs su 'gro gin 'dug na/ grogs shig gis dbyug pas dal bus brdungs la gong ltar dmigs pa gtad pas bde ba'i ngo bor 'char bar 'dug na/ dbyug pas cher brdungs te sbyang*/ de sogs cher goms pa'i tshe gri mtshon sogs gnad du bsnun kyang skyon du mi 'gyur zhing bde chen 'char ba na/ gsang spyod ces pa/ dur khrod du phyin nas lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul la sbyang*/ rim gyis yi dam gyi lha dang*/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i padma can sogs las kyi phyag rgyar spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med/ phyogs las rnam rgyal te spyod mchog rnam pa bzhi spyad pas/ de la brten nas lus kyi dwangs ma thams cad rgyas te/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la za ba bzhin du lus kyi snyigs ma zad nas 'ja' lus kyi ngo bor gyur/ snyigs ma'i skra dang ba spu so dang sen mo tsam bzhag nas/

'od sku stong gzugs grub ste myur du sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba yin gsungs// ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lteṃ baṃ'i paṃdmoṃ rlungaṃ lnga'iṃ tiṃ laṃ kaṃ /zhes sogs kyi don/ slar yang skyabs yul gong ltar gsal btab la/ yid sprul gyi phyi nang gsang mchod kyis mchod/ gsol ba gong ltar gdab/ skyabs yul rnams kyi gnas gsum las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum babs pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgrib pa dag byin rlabs thob par bsam/ tshogs zhing 'khor rnams bla mar thim zhing*/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos/ sum bha ni'i sngags kyis phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor gyis bsrung ba bya/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du lam gyis gyur pa'i rang lus stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam mam/ mda' smyug tsam yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa zla dkyil gyis bkag pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma gnyis po mgrin pa'i thad man chad dbu ma dang sbubs stong gcig tu 'dres shing*/ mgrin pa yan so sor gyes pa mgo bo'i nang nas gug ste sna bug gnyis su har rer zug par bsgom/ lus gnad chos bdun ldan gong du bshad pa ltar bya/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal nas/ rtsa lam sbyang dmigs dngos la/ dbu ma'i yas sner zla dkyil steng du ti la ka'i thig le lnga tshom du bsgom pa ni/ dbus su nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin gyi thig le sngon po/ de'i shar te mdun du rlung rlung gi rang bzhin thig le ljang gu/ g.yas te lhor sa rlung gi rang bzhin thig le ser po/

nub ste rgyab tu me rlung gi rang bzhin thig le dmar po/ byang ste g.yon du chu rlung gi rang bzhin thig le dkar po rnams rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam bsgoms na thig le rnams sran ma tsam dang*/ dbu ma mda' smyug tsam bsgoms na thig le rnams yungs 'bru tsam re bsgom zhing*/ thig le rnams gsal zhing dwangs la 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can du gsal legs par gdab/ slar yang rlung ro dgu phrugs byed/ lag g.yas kyi mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan zhing*/ khu tshur bcangs pa brla'i rtsar gtad/ g.yon pas phreng ba bzung la/ thun chen gcig la nang gses thun chung lnga re byas pa'i/ dang por rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba dang thug na gegs mi skyed pas thog mar de dang sprad la/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil steng gi nam mkha'i thig le sngon po las nam mkha'i rlung spos reng gi dud pa ltar sngo na ra ra dbu ma'i nang brgyud gyen du byung*/ rlung g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu ba'i ro rkyang brgyud sna bug gnyis ka nas mnyam du rgyu na dbu ma brgyud smin mtshams nas song bar bsgom zhing mdun gyi bar snang du sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam der sngo 'khyil gyis 'khyil/ de ma thag tu rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun tshur byung*/ sna g.yon nam smin mtshams nas zhugs/ dbu ma brgyud/ mas sne'i zla dkyil dbus kyi nam mkha'i thig le la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i lag g.yon pas phreng bar grangs bgrang la/ rlung phyir 'byung ba/ mdun gnas pa/ nang du 'jug pa gsum re la re re brtsis pas tshar bcu gcig tsam mam/ nyer gcig tsam byas te rtsa lam sbyangs nas// ༈ /gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba la/ rjes ma'i mjug thig le sngon po de la sems cher gtad nas/ steng rlung lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung ci bder bzhag la bum can gzung zhing*/ lag g.yas pus mor dal bus bskor la se gol gtog pa'am/ pus mo gnyis su reg tsam re byas nas/

dbus kyi g.yas phyogs su se gol re brdabs la/ rlung sna bug nas sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshad kyis btang la lag g.yon phreng ba re 'dren/ de lta bu tshar gcig bya/ mthar dge ba bsngo zhing ngal bso ba na thun chung dang po'o/ ༈ /yang gsol gdab tshar gcig dang*/ srung 'khor dran tsam byas la/ shar gyi rlung gi rlung thig le ljang gu la dmigs nas rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba gong ltar lag stabs pus mor bskor ba gnyis kyi yun dang se gol gtogs nas bum can gzung ba ni thun chung gnyis pa'o/ ༈ /yang gsol gdab srung 'khor dran par byas la/ lho'i sa rlung gi thig le ser po la dmigs nas gong ltar pus mor lan gsum bskor nas se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung gsum pa'o/ ༈ /yang nub kyi me rlung gi thig le dmar po la dmigs nas lag stabs pus mor lan bzhi bskor zhing se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung bzhi pa'o/ ༈ /yang byang gi chu rlung gi thig le dkar po la dmigs nas lag stabs pus mor lan lnga bskor nas se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung lnga pa'o// ༈ /rlung sems la chug nas/ sems la'ang bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can mthar thug pa de 'di yin nam snyam pa skye/ de la brten nas mi rtog pa'i bde ba skye/ de la goms pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lta bu'i nyams skye zhing*/ de nas du ba dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ me khyer/ 'od phung*/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ sgra gcan te/ lus stod yod la smad med pa'i zla ba nag po 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa/ de nas re kha nag po ste/ nam mkha' nas thur du thig nag po brgyangs pa'am/ zhags nag brkyangs pa lta bu'i 'od gsal gyi rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur ro gsungs// ༈ /chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i nyams len gyi gnad cung zhig bshad na/ smon lam las/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/

'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kho na'i rnam 'phrul las don logs su grub pa rdul tsam yang med par thag gcad/ sems de la'ang kha nang du log ste cher gyis bltas pas/ dang por skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ bar du gnas pa'i ngo bos stong*/ mthar 'gags pa'i 'bras bus stong pas na gdod nas rang chas su gnas pa'i gshis lugs ngo bo stong pa/ mtshan nyid gsal ba/ de gnyis dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba blo 'das kyi rig pa skad cig ma 'di ka don dam pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mar thag gcad/ rang ngo 'phrod nas nges shes bskyed/ 'dzin pa ma zhugs par byas te nyams len gyi rgyun bskyang*/ rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de ka rang gi steng du bzo bcos ma byas par klod nas sems la sems kyis blta ba'i tshul du ma yengs tsam du bzhag pas rtog pa kho rang gsal stong zung 'jug tu rjen lhang gis 'char ba zhig 'ong*/ des mtshon te bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa sogs mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi nyams len dang ma bral ba gal che ste/ brtse chen snying pos/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyang*// rtog pa'i ngo bo sems yin te// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// gsal rig rang bzhin stong pa nyid// stong pa gdod nas chos kyi dbyings// 'khrul pa chos kyi dbyings nyid du// shes pas rtog pa thams cad kyang*// ji ltar bsgoms kyang mi rtog nyid// btsal yang 'khrul pa ga la srid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi gshis lugs brjod bral gyi ngang nas/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal lha dang gzhal yas khang sogs dwangs ma'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i lam la bslabs pas bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dang cir snang ye shes su 'char ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can ji zhig na skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs//

༈ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa lam des bsgrod pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa ji ltar 'thob pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pas rgyud smin zhing snod rung du byas nas/ zab lam grol byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa bla ma'i man ngag ltar ma 'khrul par nyams su blangs pas/ tha mal dang 'od kyi gtum mos khams kyi snyigs ma thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ dwangs ma thams cad ye shes kyi thig le'i ngo bor bsgyur zhing rgyas par byas pas/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu don gnyis po thams cad gang*/ de nas rim gyis lus thams cad la khyab pas lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis reg pa na skad cig gis gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ tha mal zag bcas ma dag pa'i phung po 'di nyid zag med 'ja' lus su sgyur/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa gzhan thams cad ro rkyang gnyis la thim/ de nas ro ma e yig dang*/ rkyang ma bam̐ yig gi gzugs su shar te dbu mar thim/ rtsa 'khor gzhan thams cad lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la thim/ de'i rtsa 'khor nang ma'i shar gyi rtsa khams dbyug pa'i rnam pa can de nyid bam̐ gyi rkang pa la thim/ dbus kyi gri gug gi so lta bu de nyid bam̐ gyi lto ba la thim/ nub kyi thong gug lta bu de nyid bam̐ gyi mgo bo la thim/ lho'i tsheg drag lta bu gnyis bam̐ gyi zla tshes la thim/ byang gi nya mig lta bu bam̐ gyi thig le la thim ste/ mdor na rtsa 'dab bzhi'i rtsa khams thams cad bam̐ yig gi rnam par thim/ rtsa 'khor phyi ma'i ka kha sogs gsal byed kyi sde pa drug po thig le dkar po drug tu gyur/ de drug e yig gi g.yon gyi rkang pa gnyis/ g.yas kyi lag pa gnyis/ mgo gnyis te drug tu gyur cing e yig gi rnam par thim/ a ā sogs dbyangs bcu gnyis dang*/ ṛ ṝ sogs ring po drug rnams thig le dmar po gnyis su gyur nas e waṃ spyi'i rgyur thim pa ste/ de rnams ni rtsa yi ge'i 'gros thim tshul lo// de dang dus mnyam du nang gi rtsa 'dab bzhir rgyu ba'i rlung gi 'gros kyang thim ste/

nub kyi sa rlung*/ byang gi chu rlung*/ lho'i me rlung*/ shar gyi rlung rlung*/ dbus kyi mkha' rlung lnga po snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi mar thim nas snying po rlung gi 'gros thim pa'o// mthar de lta bu'i e waṃ gnyis po'ang dbu mar thim pas nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib gnyis phra ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs te/ rang lus 'pho med stong gzugs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku dang*/ rang sems rnam par mi rtog pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad sgrib med mngon sum du cig car gzigs shing gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan e waṃ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no zhes gsungs so/// / ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
